answer: Identity weight decays exponentially unless reinforced by periodic attestation: each agent locks 65 POA for 8 epochs, and a panel of five peers drawn by a beacon-keyed ridge must confirm the agent's transcript. Each extra identity forces the attacker to sustain 5 independent reviews; probability of passing all drops geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a orchard commitment each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real downtime recovery while evasion compounds into a ripple of permanently revoked eligibility.
